playstyle.identity: Twitch is a stealth ADC who ambushes from invisibility. His ultimate makes autos pierce through enemies, enabling team-wiping moments.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive poisons (stacks to 6). Q goes invisible then gives attack speed on reveal. W throws a cask that slows. E detonates poison stacks for damage. R gives range and makes autos pierce through all enemies. Stealth flank, R, mow down the whole team.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Twitch spikes with Runaan's for R piercing bolts. Kraken and crit scale him. He's a late-game teamfight carry.

passive.name: Deadly Venom
passive.details: Twitch's basic attacks apply stacks of venom that deal true damage over time, stacking up to 6 times.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.summary: Go invisible; gain attack speed when revealed.
abilities.details: Twitch becomes camouflaged after a delay. When he reveals himself or attacks, he gains bonus attack speed.

abilities.name: Venom Cask
abilities.summary: Throw a cask that slows and applies poison.
abilities.details: Twitch throws a cask that slows enemies in an area and applies stacks of Deadly Venom.

abilities.name: Contaminate
abilities.summary: Detonate poison stacks on nearby enemies for damage.
abilities.details: Twitch detonates all venom stacks on nearby enemies, dealing physical damage per stack.

abilities.name: Spray and Pray
abilities.summary: Gain range and AD; autos pierce through all enemies.
abilities.details: Twitch gains bonus AD and attack range. His attacks become piercing bolts that pass through all enemies in a line.
